use_case: Demand forecasting and automated reordering: weekly forecasts for about 68,000 SKUs and purchase orders, auto-released for replenishment lines up to $25,000
business_owner: Director of Inventory Planning (with the Vice President of Supply Chain for supplier selection)
vendor_or_model: Forecasting platform vendor (machine learning time-series models trained per customer on ERP data; SYS-15)
data_categories: 3 years of ERP order history including federal channel orders (FCI); reseller account identifiers; inventory; supplier lead times and prices; approved supplier list including brokers
affects_individuals: No (indirectly affects service levels for reseller businesses)
risk_tier: Medium (with elevated controls because purchase orders are released without human review)
human_in_the_loop: Today: none for auto-released lines under $25,000. Condition: auto-release limited to authorized sources and screened SKUs; buyers review all other suggestions and a monthly sample of auto-released lines
applicable_laws: FAR 52.204-21 and CMMC Level 1 (FCI in the feed); FAR 52.204-25 and 52.204-30 and DFARS 252.246-7008 (supplier choice); FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims)
status: In production since 2025-10; auto-release since 2026-02; approved with conditions

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant for drafting emails, product descriptions, spec sheet summaries, and scripts
vendor_or_model: Enterprise generative AI assistant (commercial terms with no training on company data; SSO; admin logging)
data_categories: Internal and Confidential data only; CUI and FCI prohibited
risk_tier: Low (approved tool with data rules); High if CUI or FCI were entered, which is prohibited and blocked
human_in_the_loop: Users check every output; product claims verified against OEM spec sheets
applicable_laws: DFARS 252.204-7012 and SP 800-171 (no CUI); FAR 52.204-21 (no FCI); FTC Act Section 5 (accurate product claims)
status: Approved for all staff after training (from 2026-10-01); public chatbots blocked

use_case: Reseller portal chatbot answering order status, product, and compatibility questions for signed-in reseller users
vendor_or_model: Portal vendor chatbot module (large language model with retrieval over the catalog and the user's orders)
data_categories: Catalog; order status for the signed-in account; reseller user names
human_in_the_loop: Answers are informational; pricing answers link to the contract price in the portal; handoff to customer service on request or low confidence
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 (accuracy of product and AI disclosures); reseller agreements (confidentiality of other resellers' data)
status: Approved with conditions; cross-account red-team test due 2026-11-15

use_case: Invoice capture and payment anomaly scoring in accounts payable
vendor_or_model: Accounts payable automation vendor (document extraction and anomaly scoring models)
data_categories: Supplier invoices; supplier bank details; payment history
human_in_the_loop: AP clerks approve every invoice; the score is advisory only and never replaces call-back verification or dual approval
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 not directly relevant; internal controls over payments
status: Approved with conditions (score documented as advisory)

use_case: Resume screening module in the applicant tracking system that ranks and screens applicants for hourly DC roles in Florida
vendor_or_model: Applicant tracking system vendor (ranking model with knockout questions)
data_categories: Applicant resumes and answers; work history; availability
human_in_the_loop: Condition: no applicant is rejected by the module alone; a recruiter reviews every screen-out and every ranked list before interviews
applicable_laws: Title VII disparate impact (42 U.S.C. 2000e-2(k)); Uniform Guidelines adverse impact analysis (29 CFR 1607.4(D)); ADA accommodation in the application process; Florida has no AI hiring statute identified
status: Screen-out function suspended 2026-09-10 pending adverse impact analysis (due 2026-11-30); ranking continues with human review
